description: A sofa made of joined sections that can form a corner or L shape.
A convertible frame whose seat cushion is the mattress, folding flat into a bed; sold with or without its mattress.
A long seat for several people, with or without a back; some have storage.
A padded seat or footrest without back or arms; some have storage.
A light folding bed on a frame, used for camping or guests (called a cot in the US).
A desk whose height adjusts between sitting and standing.
A cabinet that stands in a room and keeps cigars at a set humidity.
A bound or binder album made to hold photographic prints, sold empty.
